messages:
nora (Eng): Hey team  swapping houses with a friend in Barcelona for 6 weeks (Apr 10 -> May 22). Do I need to declare? worried about WFH stipend, Spanish social security, and shipping my standing desk. :airplane:
raj (People Ops): Yes please file the temporary homebase form for any stay >30 days. It helps payroll/tax & export controls. Link: https://hr.redwood.example/homebase-declare
nora (Eng): If I declare, does the WFH stipend continue? is it prorated across two months?
maria (Finance): Stipend is prorated by actual calendar days in each pay period. If Apr 10-30 + May 1-22 we'll split Apr and May accordingly. We calculate on payroll run and confirm in your paystub.
nora (Eng): Barcelona might create social security exposure. Will Redwood register locally or will I remain on US payroll?maria (Finance): Intl short stints are reviewed case-by-case. Our tax vendor will look at Spain's 183/183 rules and potential S.S. obligations. Expect a review within 7 business days after you submit the form. We'll post whether local payroll or gross-up is required.
emily (Manager): Emily here  I approve the house swap and equipment shipping if POps clears it. Nora, please include handover notes for the two-week sprint.
nora (Eng): About the desk  can I ship my adjustable desk and leave it there? customs seems messy.
equip-bot: For international temporary moves, equipment shipping covered up to $150. Shipping bulky items like desks may exceed allowance and could trigger customs. Please open an equipment ticket and attach the declare form. Manager pre-approval required for >$150 or items requiring import paperwork.
nora (Eng): Ticket EQ-7783 opened for desk shipping and short-term monitor reroute. Attached homebase-declare draft.
raj (People Ops): Thanks Nora. Two notes: 1) Manager approval required for equipment over limit (Emily acknowledged). 2) Update your emergency contact/address in ADP so payroll notices reach you.
nora (Eng): Done. Also any impacts to benefits or worker comp?
raj (People Ops): Benefits stay on your permanent homebase for <182 days. Worker comp also remains with US homebase unless duration triggers a change. We'll flag Legal if needed.
maria (Finance): After payroll/tax vendor review we'll post whether Spain withholding or social security applies and any expected take-home impact. Plan for up to 7 business days.
ora (Eng): Submitted form. hr-bot: "homebase-declare" submitted by nora at 3109876543. Next steps: POps review -> Payroll/TAX vendor review -> EQ-7783 equipment processing.
emily (Manager): I approved EQ-7783 and customs up to $200 for the desk. Tag me if FedEx needs additional paperwork.
raj (People Ops): All set  we'll update this thread when payroll posts the tax/social security determination. Have fun in Barcelona! :es:
